title: Component Markings: What You Can Read
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning electronics component identification
description: An interactive five-column infographic comparing visible markings on resistors, diodes, transistors, capacitors, and integrated circuits.

learningObjectives: Distinguish information that can be read from component markings from information that must be confirmed in a datasheet.

keyQuestions: Which markings indicate orientation or polarity?
Which safety-critical facts require a datasheet?
commonMisconceptions: A transistor flat face guarantees one universal pinout.
Package size alone reveals every electrical rating.
